bullets.title: NVDA: HSBC raises PT to $360; Poolside AI deal; China chip denial; ECOC read-across
bullets.body: HSBC raised Nvidia's PT to $360 from $325. Separately, Nvidia is licensing AI models from coding startup Poolside for $6B + $1B equity investment at a $12B valuation, with most of Poolside's engineering team joining Nvidia. Nvidia denied reports of a China-specific LPU chip in small-batch shipments. Key read-across next week: Nvidia reports Aug 26 with buy-side expecting $95B July revenue and $108B October guidance (+14% Q/Q), with Rubin architecture (13k+ racks C26) as centerpiece.

bullets.title: MRVL: Multiple PT raises to $290-$350 on Google partnership; reports Aug 27
bullets.body: Roth raises MRVL PT to $350 (Buy), Oppenheimer to $300, and Opco raises to $300 (Outperform), all citing Google's expanded partnership covering AI inference accelerators, storage controllers, and NICs with up to $120B qualifying revenue ceiling through 2033, plus 59M warrants to Google. Jefferies expects MRVL to beat/raise when it reports Aug 27 (est. $2.8B vs. Street $2.7B; Oct guidance $3.1B vs. $3.025B); custom AI ASIC business targeting $4B+ in CY26 and >$10B by CY28.

bullets.title: AVGO: Mizuho initiates Outperform $530 PT; raising $60B+ in AI debt for Anthropic
bullets.body: Mizuho initiated AVGO at Outperform with a $530 PT, citing full technology capability to deliver Google's massive TPU deployment ambitions via ASIC/SerDes/advanced packaging leadership. BMO also initiated Outperform. Separately, Broadcom is in talks with Blackstone and Apollo to raise $60B+ in AI chip financing (potentially reaching $100B total) to help Anthropic and others secure chips and data center capacity, with a $30B junior tranche via SPV structure.

bullets.title: ORCL: VA raises Cerner contract ceiling ~$17B to ~$27B through 2031
bullets.body: The VA increased Oracle Health/Cerner contract ceiling by ~$17B (170% increase) to ~$27B, potentially extending through May 2031. Only 14 of 164 VA medical centers are currently live, implying substantial multi-year deployment revenue across software, hosting, and support. Mizuho views this as de-risking ORCL's largest government contract and validation of its healthcare turnaround.

bullets.title: BABA: JPM raises PT to $210 on AI Cloud rerating; 45% cloud growth, 22% IRR
bullets.body: JPMorgan raised BABA PT to $210 (OW) after 1QFY27 showed AI Cloud & Compute revenue up 45% YoY with EBITA margin at 12% and 133% EBITDA growth; AI product revenue annualizes near Rmb50B. JPM models >50% cloud growth and ~22% after-tax IRR on incremental AI capex vs. ~10% cost of capital, with a ~3-year payback. The 18% EPS headline miss was driven by non-cash items (goodwill impairment, EU DSA fine, lower investment income), with the EBITDA beat of 6%. Conference call is the key swing factor.

bullets.title: WMT: Multiple PT cuts to $125-$135 as comps decelerate; maintains OW/Buy ratings
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley cut WMT PT from $140 to $125 (OW), Citi to $132 from $147 (Buy), UBS to $130 from $141 (Buy), and KeyBanc to $135 from $145 (OW). U.S. comps decelerated to +2.6% in 2Q27 (3.4% ex-Health/Wellness). Key headwinds: $600M tariff refund benefit in 2Q will reverse in 3Q, weaker lower-income consumer, and 3Q EPS guidance of $0.62-0.64 vs. consensus $0.67. E-commerce (+23%), advertising (+38%), and marketplace (+52%) remain bright spots. WMT suffered its largest single-day decline in 4+ years.

bullets.title: NFLX: JPM reiterates OW; double-digit revenue CAGR through 2028, engagement steady
bullets.body: JPMorgan maintained Overweight on Netflix and projects double-digit revenue CAGR through 2028 with normalized operating margin expansion of 165bps annually in 2027-2028. Netflix has ~5% global TV view share and <45% broadband household penetration. Cloud gaming MAUs up 11x in 8 months; ad revenue expected to double to $3.1B in 2026. Piper also reiterates Overweight, highlighting recent AI-bucket pullback as accumulation opportunity.

bullets.title: SPOT: Upsizes share buyback by $1.5B to $2.2B total
bullets.body: Spotify upsized its share repurchase authorization by $1.5B, bringing total authorization to approximately $2.2B. JPMorgan reiterated its overweight stance. Stock up ~0.7% in pre-market.

bullets.title: CRM: KeyBanc stays Sector Weight; Agentforce still in POC phases, demand tepid
bullets.body: KeyBanc maintains Sector Weight on CRM ahead of Aug 26 earnings; channel checks show Agentforce still in proof-of-concept with pricing complexity and partner preference for Anthropic over Agentforce. Organic subscription revenue expected to decelerate to 6.8% in F2Q27. JPM notes 2H subscription revenue reacceleration is necessary to flip the bear thesis (analyst moved to Overweight). Wolfe channel checks show Slack/Slackbot strength but Marketing & Commerce weakness.

bullets.title: MDB: Evercore ISI initiates Outperform with $525 PT (25% upside); Goldman favors for AI
bullets.body: Evercore ISI initiated MongoDB at Outperform with a $525 PT implying 25% upside from $420. Goldman Sachs also lists MDB as a preferred AI-levered idea in software, alongside MSFT and RBRK.

bullets.title: DKNG: Mizuho upgrades to Outperform, $45 PT on prediction market overhang clearing
bullets.body: Mizuho upgraded DraftKings to Outperform with a $45 PT (15.5x 2027E EBITDA of $1.3B), arguing courts have sided with states in 16 of 23 prediction market decisions. DKNG is down 27% YTD on prediction market fears; the company is spending ~$300M annually on prediction markets. Upcoming 9th, 4th, and 6th circuit rulings could remove regulatory uncertainty.

bullets.title: ANET: Piper reiterates OW; use AI pullback as accumulation opportunity
bullets.body: Piper Sandler reiterates Overweight on Arista, citing management confidence in hyper-growth persisting into 2027 across scale-up/out/across, hyperscalers, enterprise, and campus refresh opportunities. Recent pullback in AI-linked stocks viewed as an accumulation entry point; supply comfort driving guide raises with further easing a potential catalyst.

bullets.title: EQIX/DLR: Singapore awards 50MW each; EQIX best positioned for AI interconnection
bullets.body: Singapore distributed 200MW of new data center capacity (50MW each) to Equinix, Digital Realty, Keppel, and ST Telemedia—carrier-neutral colocation preferred over hyperscaler builds. Morgan Stanley identifies EQIX as best positioned for colocation upside via underappreciated interconnection monetization and sovereign AI infrastructure trends; virtual interconnections growing as AI agents drive machine-generated traffic.

bullets.title: LITE: Wolfe upgrades to Outperform, $1,200 PT on 10-K signals and AI optical demand
bullets.body: Wolfe raised Lumentum to Outperform with a $1,200 PT (36.5% upside), citing 10-K signals including 30% headcount growth, purchase obligations up 45% Y/Y to $2.6B, building consolidation suggesting capacity prep, and new M&A language. Long-term structural driver: copper-to-optical transition within servers. Valuation of 21x CY28E EPS viewed as cheap for 40-50%+ growth with margin expansion.

bullets.title: MU: $10B Boise Research Labs; AI memory upcycle intact; bullish signals renewed
bullets.body: Micron announced a $10B Micron Research Labs investment in Boise with a decade-plus horizon, part of the broader $50B Boise expansion including two new fabs and 17,000+ jobs. Citi notes the memory upcycle is intact on tight inventories and strong KV cache demand. Hedgeye renewed bullish TRADE and TREND signals. HBM shortage driving AI chipmakers toward scale-out strategies.

bullets.title: RDDT: Morgan Stanley cuts PT to $210 from $240, stays OW on Google traffic headwind
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley maintained Overweight on Reddit but cut PT from $240 to $210, lowering EV/EBITDA multiple from 22x to 15x due to weak US user growth and Google Search algorithm changes reducing new user discovery. Revenue/EPS revised higher with 59%/37% growth for '26/'27 forecast; licensing deal renegotiation in 2027 viewed as key catalyst (currently modeling $140M conservatively).

bullets.title: SNDK: Pricing and volume each ~50% of FY27 Q1 earnings growth
bullets.body: Per Tianfeng Securities interview with SanDisk IR, pricing is a slightly larger contributor to FY27 Q1 earnings growth, with pricing and volume each accounting for roughly half. Hedgeye renewed bullish signals on SNDK alongside MU and MRVL.

bullets.title: CHTR: Cox merger closes; becomes world's largest cable operator at 70M+ locations
bullets.body: Charter Communications completed its merger with Cox Communications, creating the world's largest cable operator passing over 70 million locations and operating under the Spectrum brand.

bullets.title: TSLA: Solar Roof discontinued; AV licenses in Nevada
bullets.body: Tesla discontinued its Solar Roof tiles product, citing lack of economic viability. Separately, Tesla was granted 5,000 AV licenses in Nevada, though the chief engineer expects deployment of only ~2,500 in the next year. Hedgeye and Hedgeye rate TSLA bearish with a range of $323-$355.

bullets.title: ROST: Strong 2Q beat (+10% comps, EPS $2.06); FY guidance raised materially
bullets.body: Ross Stores reported Q2 comps of +10% (vs. Street +7.6%) driven by new customers, lapsed customer recovery, and frequency. EPS of $2.06 excl. tariff benefit beat consensus $1.94. FY26 comp guidance raised to +8.5-9.5% (from +6-7%), FY EPS guidance raised to $8.61-8.77 (from $7.50-7.74). Citi raised PT to $290 (Buy); UBS raised PT 3% to $239, staying Neutral on crowding and limited P/E upside. Q3 guidance +6-7%, Q4 +4-5%.
